method: Each entry's notice page and plate page were rendered from the custody PDF (pdftoppm) and read directly. Identification rests on the rendered notice page's 'Designation originelle' line and monument description. The PDFs' embedded OCR text layer was used only to locate entries, never as witness content.
record: Spec 103 Stage 2 witness data: the eight previously unwitnessed held-out texts in the REM (Leclant (dir.) et al., Repertoire d'Epigraphie Meroitique, Paris, 2000), custody copies at ~/.syncyard/worktrees/glossa/glossa-custody/spec103/ on tower-compute

uniform_finding: None of the eight entries prints a transliteration of its inscription. The REM entry form for these texts is a notice (location, original designation, monument identification, dimensions, inscription description, bibliography) plus plates reproducing a photograph and, where one exists, the original publication's hand copy or facsimile. There is therefore no REM transliteration token stream to transcribe for any of the eight texts, and the witness_token_stream is null for each.
